### Data Read (12)
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific item by its ID.
- `GET /category/{categoryId}` — Get information about a specific category.
- `GET /category/sports/all-sports` — Get a list of all sports categories.
- `GET /ideas/feed` — Fetch a feed of ideas.
- `GET /ideas/posts/{postId}` — Retrieve a specific idea post by its ID.
- `GET /product-info/manual-banner-details.json` — Retrieve manual banner details.
- `GET /v1/{v1Id}/` — Get details for a specific resource.
- `GET /v1/exchange/status` — Check the current exchange status.
- `GET /v1/location` — Determine the user's location.
- `GET /v1/social/{socialId}` — Retrieve social data by ID.
- `GET /v1/social/posts/{postId}/comments` — Get comments for a specific social post.
- `GET /v1/social/profile/{profileId}` — Get a social profile by ID.

### Data Write (1)

### Search (1)
